BiblicalUsage: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? says Jeremiah, for to thee doth it appertain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fear belongs to God the way a crown belongs to a king: it is not flattery but fitness, and among all the wise of the nations there is none like Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
